name: bem-ls
description: BEM class checks, completion, navigation and SCSS ghost text for React components and their stylesheets.

bem.naming.preset.markdownDescription: classic: block__elem--mod. kv: block__elem--key_value. react: Block-elem_mod_value. custom: your own separators and patterns.

bem.naming.valueSeparator.markdownDescription: Separator before a modifier value (kv: "_"). Empty disables values.

bem.naming.block.markdownDescription: Regular expression a block name must match (anchors are added).

bem.naming.element.markdownDescription: Regular expression an element name must match.

bem.naming.modifier.markdownDescription: Regular expression a modifier name must match.

bem.naming.value.markdownDescription: Regular expression a modifier value must match.

invalidName.markdownDescription: A class doesn't follow the naming convention. Default: warning.

nestedElement.markdownDescription: An element of an element, like b__e1__e2. Default: info.

modifierWithoutBase.markdownDescription: b--m on an element without b. Default: warning.

elementOutsideBlock.markdownDescription: b__e with no ancestor using block b. Default: warning.

multipleBlocksMix.markdownDescription: One element carries two different blocks. Default: info.

missingInStylesheet.markdownDescription: A class has no selector in the component's stylesheet. Default: warning.

unusedSelector.markdownDescription: A stylesheet class no component uses (shown faded). Default: hint.

moduleClassMissing.markdownDescription: styles.x where the CSS module has no .x. Default: error.

bem.ignore.markdownDescription: Regular expressions; matching classes are skipped by every rule and by skeleton generation, e.g. "^js-".

bem.stylesheet.lookup.markdownDescription: Strategies, in order: an imported stylesheet, a sibling with the same name, another stylesheet in the directory, parent directories. Default: `["import","sibling","directory","parent"]`.

bem.stylesheet.extensions.markdownDescription: Stylesheet suffixes tried, in order, for sibling and parent lookups. Default: `[".module.scss",".scss",".module.css",".css",".module.sass",".sass"]`.

bem.stylesheet.maxSearchDepth.markdownDescription: How many parent directories the parent lookup searches. Default: `2`.

bem.stylesheet.loadPaths.markdownDescription: Directories (relative to the root) Sass also searches for @use/@import.

bem.stylesheet.aliases.markdownDescription: Import prefixes mapped to root-relative directories, e.g. {"@/": "src/"}.

bem.stylesheet.exclude.markdownDescription: Directory names skipped when indexing the workspace. Default: `["node_modules",".git","dist","build","out","coverage",".next",".turbo","vendor"]`.

bem.stylesheet.globalFallback.markdownDescription: Resolve variables, mixins and functions that aren't reachable through @use/@import to a global definition anywhere in the workspace (for injected partials).

bem.generator.nesting.markdownDescription: dom: nest by the JSX tree. bem: one rule per block, nested by class name.

bem.jsx.classFunctions.markdownDescription: Helpers whose arguments are class names. Default: `["clsx","classnames","classNames","cx","cn","twMerge","twJoin"]`.

bem.cssModules.identifiers.markdownDescription: Identifiers treated as CSS modules even without an import. Names bound by a stylesheet import are detected automatically. Default: `["styles","classes"]`.

bem.styledComponents.identifiers.markdownDescription: styled-components factories, as in styled.div``. Default: `["styled"]`.

bem.ghostText.enabled.markdownDescription: Suggest missing BEM selectors as ghost text in stylesheets.

bem.misc.diagnosticsDelay.markdownDescription: Milliseconds to wait after a change before checking. Default: `200`.

bem.misc.scanOnStartup.markdownDescription: Index the workspace in the background at startup.

bem.server.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `bem-ls` binary. Empty: the bundled binary, then `bem-ls` on the `PATH`.

bem.trace.server.markdownDescription: Log the messages exchanged with the server to the BEM output channel.
